overview.text: Iran vows to end the U.S. naval blockade by all available means, as Trump acknowledges increasing Iranian attacks but says they have done no damage.
Three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday, and NATO's Rutte is working to reassure eastern allies as incursions increase.
Immigration agents arrested a father and daughter at Seattle-Tacoma airport, drawing outrage and prompting some flight crew to ask to be replaced.
Nvidia's Jensen Huang is still set to testify before Congress next week after being reinstated as CEO.
The longest UN climate talks in history ended with no deal after oil producers blocked language on phasing out fossil fuels.
Measles poses a growing risk to U.S. adults, including some vaccinated before 1989, medical experts said.

stories.headline: Trump targets Newsom over death sentence commutations in DOJ speech
stories.summary: In a Justice Department speech on violent crime, President Trump condemned California Governor Gavin Newsom's decision to commute hundreds of death sentences.

stories.headline: Iran vows to end U.S. naval blockade by 'all available means'
stories.summary: Iran says it will force the U.S. to lift its blockade. Trump acknowledged Iran's increasing attacks but said they have "done no damage."
stories.why: Escalation at sea between the U.S. and Iran carries security and energy risks.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang still to testify before Congress next week
stories.summary: Congressional panels confirmed Huang will testify as scheduled, after he was reinstated Monday as Nvidia CEO. He had resigned earlier this month amid allegations of affairs.

stories.headline: Russian incursions into NATO territory increase after missiles land in Poland
stories.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
stories.why: Spillover from Russia's war is testing NATO's eastern flank.

stories.headline: Outrage after ICE arrests father and daughter at Seattle airport
stories.summary: The arrest was caught on camera as passengers boarded an Alaska Airlines flight. Some crew members asked to be replaced, and the family has spoken out.
stories.why: It raises questions over how immigration arrests are carried out in public places.

stories.headline: UK sanctions Myanmar military leaders after UN court genocide ruling
stories.summary: Britain sanctioned top Myanmar military leaders after a UN court ruled against Myanmar over the Rohingya. The decision sets a precedent with implications for a similar case over Israel's actions in Gaza.
stories.why: The ruling may shape how international law is applied elsewhere.

stories.headline: COP31 climate talks collapse in clash over fossil fuels
stories.summary: The longest UN climate talks ever ended without a deal. European and vulnerable nations rejected a draft after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.
stories.why: Without a deal, global climate commitments remain stalled.

stories.headline: Measles a growing risk for U.S. adults, experts say
stories.summary: Danger is greatest for the unvaccinated, but vaccinated people born before 1989 may no longer be sufficiently protected, medical experts said.
stories.why: Adults may want to check their vaccination status with a doctor.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in $44 billion cybersecurity deal
stories.summary: CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler, combining two major cybersecurity firms as worries grow about hacks fueled by advances in artificial intelligence.
